readings.name: Mood
anchors: Down — the day feels dull and downhill
Bright — glad to be in this day
alternates: Easy — glad in a quiet way
Lit up — glad to be here

readings.name: Irritation
anchors: None — nothing is getting to me
Faint — a small thing or two scratched
Some — a shorter fuse than usual
alternates: Calm — nothing gets under my skin
Slight — a small thing or two grated

readings.name: Stress
readings.prompt: How much is pressing on you
anchors: Light — a task or two on my mind
Wound tight — pressure most of the time
alternates: Mild — a thing or two on my mind
Braced — under pressure most of the time

readings.name: Overwhelm
readings.prompt: How much there is to hold
anchors: Clear — I can see what to do
Full but ordered — I know where to start
Crowded — more than fits, still workable
Swamped — can't see where to start
Buried — shut down by how much there is
alternates: Open — I can see what to do next
Busy but sorted — I know the first step
Flooded — no idea where to start
Frozen — shut down by the size of it

readings.name: Motivation
anchors: None — nothing pulls me to do anything
Faint — I'd rather not, but might
Middling — I'll do what's in front of me
Ready — there are things I want to get to
Pulled — I want to start now
alternates: Inert — nothing pulls me toward anything
Reluctant — I would rather not, but could
Keen — things I want to get to
Eager — I want to start this minute

readings.name: Confidence
anchors: Doubting — I expect to get things wrong
Shaky — unsure I'm up to it
Even — no strong sense either way
Solid — I trust myself with whatever comes
alternates: Unsure — I expect to get it wrong
Wobbly — not sure I am up to it
Certain — I trust myself with what comes

readings.name: Focus
anchors: Fair — I can focus with effort
Held — attention stays where I put it
Locked in — nothing pulls me off

readings.name: Loneliness
anchors: Connected — or fine on my own
Faint — a small wish for company
Cut off — alone even around people
alternates: Mild — a passing wish for company
Walled off — alone even in company

readings.name: Social energy
anchors: Empty — I want no one around
Low — one quiet person at most
Up for it — I'd enjoy people
alternates: Thin — one quiet person, no more

readings.name: Energy
anchors: Buzzing — could run up a hill
alternates: Fizzing — could run up a hill

readings.name: Hunger
anchors: Full — satisfied, no wish to eat
